slides: Your muscles don’t grow from comfort.
They adapt only when you add a little more load.
That extra weight forces fibers to recruit new motor units.
Those units rebuild stronger, and your mitochondria get more efficient.
So schedule a 2‑5% increase each week and watch stamina rise.
Decision fatigue is the silent saboteur of goals.
Each trivial choice drains neural bandwidth.
When bandwidth drops, willpower collapses.
Pre‑define routines for the low‑stakes moments.
Reserve mental energy for the choices that truly matter.
You train hard, but sleep hard‑lights the results.
Growth hormone spikes during deep REM cycles.
Those spikes stitch muscle fibers and clear cortisol.
A consistent 7‑9 hour window aligns that hormonal rhythm.
Prioritize sleep like a workout; the gains will follow.
Alignment is the gap between who you claim to be and what you do.
When actions echo values, friction disappears.
Friction fuels procrastination and self‑doubt.
Audit weekly: list core values, then map each task to one.
Close the gap; momentum becomes automatic.
